name: TC-834: creating a chain promotion asks 'This will affect all N locations', and Continue saves it for the chain
description: Chain shell → Create promotion → Money off the order, named, 10% off, code only → Turn on opens 'Heads up — chain-wide change' with 'create a promotion … This will affect all N locations in your chain.' (N = the chain's member count); Continue → back on the list with the row Live, and GET /api/chains/:gid/promotions has it.
